name: Progress MS-21
about: Progress MS-21 (2022-140A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2022 Oct 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Oct 26), held fixed
docked to S36086; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
